title: Entry Thresholds and Patronage Standing of the Refined Fuels and Propane Programmes
content:
A member is written onto a programme of Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts on the entry terms the catalogue fixes for it, and the programme then decides whether the gallons bought on it earn patronage allocation and what capital is retained per gallon to the member's equity account.

## Entry terms by programme

| Programme | Credit review called for | Gallons a year the programme is carried above | Tank called for | Years of membership called for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Will-Call Propane Account | no | 0 | yes | 0 |
| Keep-Full Automatic Delivery Account | yes | 400 | yes | 0 |
| Budget Payment Plan Account | yes | 600 | yes | 1 |
| Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account | yes | 1000 | yes | 1 |
| Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account | yes | 2500 | no | 1 |
| Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account | yes | 5000 | no | 2 |

## Patronage standing by programme

| Programme | Gallons earn patronage allocation | Capital retained, USD per gallon |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Will-Call Propane Account | no | 0.0000 |
| Keep-Full Automatic Delivery Account | yes | 0.0015 |
| Budget Payment Plan Account | yes | 0.0015 |
| Contract Gallon Pre-Buy Account | yes | 0.0015 |
| Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery Account | yes | 0.0015 |
| Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account | yes | 0.0015 |

## Notes

1. The yearly gallons figure is the use below which the programme is not carried. It rises from 0 gallons on the Will-Call Propane Account through 400, 600, 1000 and 2500 gallons to 5000 gallons on the Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Account.
2. The Will-Call Propane Account is the only programme written without a credit review and the only one on which gallons earn no patronage allocation; its retain accordingly stands at 0.0000 USD per gallon.
3. The five programmes that earn patronage all retain capital at the same figure, 0.0015 USD per gallon, so the retain does not vary with the programme once the member is above the entry programme.
4. A tank is called for on the four propane programmes and not on the Bulk Farm Fuel Delivery or Cardtrol Fleet Fueling Accounts.
